summary: Phil deepens his reading at Berkeley public schools, encountering early-childhood favorites that will recur in the Exegesis: A.A. Milne, Wind in the Willows, Pinocchio, and (by year-end) the first science-fiction pulps that he subsequently identifies as the formative encounter with the genre.
notes: PKD locates his first SF pulp encounter (Stirring Science Stories, sometimes Astounding) in this period; the dating is approximate and varies across his retellings.
